pages.text: Inside claimed land:$(li)Friendly animals never despawn, even without a name tag (not monsters or fish)$(li)Grappling hooks work for everyone$(li)Only your party can build or open chests
Other players can't hurt your tamed pets.$(br2)Whales won't attack your boats.$(br2)Butterflies, fireflies and critters live in almost every biome. Bring a net and a jar!
